run_linear_crf_training: run the linear chain CRF example to train and evaluate a sequence labeling model
create_transition_graph: create a bigram transition graph for a CRF with a given number of output classes
create_potential_graph: create a unary potential graph mapping input features to output classes for a CRF
compute_crf_loss: compute the negative log likelihood loss for a CRF given input and target sequences
sample_crf_model: sample training data from a linear chain CRF model using Viterbi decoding
